answers.rationale: Protein up (padj 9.9e-43). CPTAC and TCGA RNA both up. RCC has the largest transcript share (0.976) and the purity bound is 6.65 (>0). Surface call is surface. Vital IHC level is 1 and the proteome is not enriched. DepMap shows no dependent lines, so dependency is no.

Protein is down and CPTAC and TCGA RNA are both down, so replicated is yes. Macrophage share (0.574) exceeds RCC (0.233), so not tumour-intrinsic. The surface call is internal. Heart IHC level is 2. DepMap selectivity is negative. The loss_biomarker rule applies before infiltration_signal.

Protein up. CPTAC RNA, TCGA RNA and confirmatory protein are all up. RCC has the largest share (0.327) and the purity bound is 3.17 (>0). Surface call is surface. Vital IHC level is 1 (kidney is not vital) and the proteome is not enriched. DepMap fails on selectivity and dependent lines.

Protein is down. CPTAC RNA is down but TCGA RNA is up and significant, so replicated is no. RCC has the largest share but the purity bound (-4.9) is below 0, so tumour_intrinsic is insufficient. There is no surface record. The proteome reports vital enrichment. DepMap fails. No verdict rule applies, so needs_more_data.
